# Header icons — Material Design Icons only

Every column header in a `gcs-table` gets an icon — that's a hard rule, not
a nice-to-have (see SKILL.md). Icons come **exclusively from Google's
Material Design Icons / Material Symbols**
(https://github.com/google/material-design-icons — the same set self-hosted
in this repo at `assets/icons/`).

**Never** use Font Awesome, Heroicons, Feather, Lucide, or ad-hoc/custom
icons — no exceptions, even if the destination site happens to load one of
those libraries. (This is a 2026-07 policy change: an older version of this
skill allowed Font Awesome when the destination loaded it. It no longer
does; Material only.)

Delivery is always **inline SVG** with `fill="currentColor"`, so the icon
colors itself off the header text with zero extra network requests and
zero dependencies. Never reference an icon with `<img src="...">` — that's
for the flags, not the icons — and never leave a header without one.

The wrapper markup is always the same; only the `<path d="...">` changes:

```html
<span class="gcs-table__th-icon"><svg viewBox="0 -960 960 960" fill="currentColor" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="…"/></svg></span>
```

## Anything else

Not every column maps to one of the icons above. Look in
`assets/icons/outlined/` in this design system repo — it has ~3,900
Material Symbols icons (in plain and `-fill` variants) named after their
concept (`local_hospital`, `savings`, `business_center`, `diversity_3`,
etc). Open the matching `<name>.svg`, copy the `d` value the same way, and
set `fill="currentColor"` on the `<svg>` (the source files don't have a
`fill` attribute, so this is always safe to add). If working outside this
repo, the same files live at
https://github.com/google/material-design-icons — always copy the path,
never link the icon as an image.

## Footer brand logo

Every table footer carries the exact inline SVG of the GCS secondary logo.
Which colour variant to use depends on the footer surface:

**Routing rule:**
- `data-footer="light"` (white footer surface — Templates 01 and 03) → **blue logo** (`fill="#000957"`)
- `data-theme="dark"` / `data-card="deep"` (navy footer surface — Template 02) → **white logo** (`fill="white"`)

Never reference the logo with `<img src="...">` (breaks outside this repo),
never approximate it with text or a CSS shape, and never substitute
`Primary`, `Symbol`, or any other logo variant.

---

(`#000957`) against the white footer band.
